overview: RTL Samstag Nacht was a comedy show, which ran from 6 November 1993 to 23 May 1998 on the German TV network RTL. RTL Samstag Nacht was the first major comedy show in German television, created after the example of the long-running American show Saturday Night Live and broadcast late on Saturday night. It helped comedy in German television to a breakthrough and was a model for several later comedy shows. Karl Ranseier was a recurring character featured in fake news reports telling about his death at the end of each episode. The name Karl Ranseier has become a catchphrase in Germany that has led to its own joke category of Ranseiers which are in widespread usage outside of the comedy origin.
title: RTL Samstag Nacht

Inside the store were Ryoji, a photographer; Daiya, a model; and Soichiro - Daiya's uncle. Takumi recalls his past love at first sight for Ryoji and the words he said to him at that time.... "How do you want to live?" Ryoji does not remember at all, and Takumi has been living his life hiding the fact that he loves men. Ryoji and Daiya, who are friends, try to share a room, but due to cost issues, they are looking for another tenant. Daiya, who has a good sense of humor, welcomes Takumi, whom he has never met before, as the third member of the group. Takumi, who unexpectedly ends up living with the person he loves, Ryoji, who is not serious about love, and Daiya, who seems to be living a carefree life. The host takes his companions to places that have played an important role in their lives, while also giving them tasks that push them out of their comfort zones. They spend the night in the camper or a tent, and András Sváby takes care of dinner. Beautiful landscapes, honest moments, challenges, campfires, cooking, a camper van, no gadgets — this is what Tell Me Along the Way has in store for viewers. The guests will include Róbert Alföldi, Péter Geszti, Mariann Falusi, Csaba "Cyla" Kajdi, László Lakatos, Réka Rubint, Győző Szabó, and Liliána Szilágyi.
